<div class="facts"><div class="fact"><small>Error ID</small><b>ST-APP-007</b></div><div class="fact"><small>Area</small><b>Dashboards, rules and reports</b></div><div class="fact wide"><small>Where you see it</small><b>Alarm rules</b></div></div>

## Why it happens

In 4.3.0.57 the "missing for" (no data) condition of alarm rules is not evaluated, so it never fires.

## Fix it

Raise the alarm from the device's inactivity instead. See [Alarm when a device is offline](/docs/user-guide/rule-engine-2-0/tutorials/create-inactivity-alarm/).

## Check that it worked

Stopping the device raises the alarm after the timeout.
